zh: 只在另一项打开时才起作用的设置行现在随父项一起变灰、不能操作（重绘模型选择器与重绘权限控件随「重绘对话框」，对话统计信息位置随重绘覆盖对话页，封号彩蛋随「折叠侧栏设置区」），变灰的行仍显示你设的值，说明下面用强调色写明它在等哪一项。
en: Settings rows that only work while another setting is on grey out and take no input with it — the model picker and the permission control with the composer restyle, the statistics position with the restyle covering the conversation, the easter egg with the sidebar settings — and a greyed row still shows the value you set, with a line in the accent colour saying what it waits for.
